text: At its meeting of November 8 and 9, 2023, City Council directed the General Manager, Transportation Services to present the list of new priority locations for community safety zones at the next meeting of Infrastructure and Environment Committee. A framework and expanded criteria for establishing Community Safety Zones outside of School Zones was developed by Transportation Services and adopted by City Council in November 2023. The new framework will be used to evaluate requests from Councillors for new Community Safety Zone designations outside of school frontages with the goal of enabling future Automated Speed Enforcement implementation at those locations. Staff are currently reviewing sites for the next mobile Automated Speed Enforcement rotation which is planned for spring 2024.
